name: patch-lang
description: Patch: a tiny change-oriented programming language with semantic change contracts, Lean-checked source/runtime correspondence, direct WebAssembly, portable C99/FreeBSD execution, and cross-platform Studio builds

scripts.build:example: node src/cli.js build examples/score.patch --kind console --target portable --out Score.patchapp
scripts.build:wasm: node src/cli.js build examples/score.patch --kind console --target wasm --out Score.wasm
scripts.build:wasm-direct: node src/cli.js build examples/direct-wasm-recipes.patch --kind console --target wasm-direct --out DirectRecipes.wasm
scripts.build:c99: node src/cli.js build examples/direct-wasm-recipes.patch --kind console --target c99 --out DirectRecipes.c
scripts.build:web: node src/cli.js build examples/direct-wasm-recipes.patch --kind console --target web --out DirectRecipes.html
scripts.build:native: node src/cli.js build examples/direct-wasm-recipes.patch --kind console --target native --name DirectRecipes
scripts.build:app: node src/cli.js build examples/direct-wasm-recipes.patch --kind console --target app --name DirectRecipes
